bindings.why: After same-run restored-world attestation, the real public CLI creates and gets a Supplier as Director, and independent native reads find the new draft once. An invalid native Link refuses INVALID_INPUT without insertion. A member is refused the native role with exact error/exit and no Supplier. Preparation is only a prerequisite, never a replacement for these public operations.

The public CLI creates a new 2.74 Purchase Invoice with no GL, submits it, then runs General Ledger through the same public door. Native submitted document and balanced debit/credit rows independently equal the public report. Repeating the same submit id returns the same result and creates no extra posting.
Successful public create prints exactly doctype/name/docstatus/fields JSON, with a nonempty native name, Supplier type and draft status; the source Supplier exists.
Successful public report prints exactly columns and rows arrays of records, including the independently sourced selected voucher.
A native invalid Supplier Group is sent through public create. Exit2, empty stdout and exactly error code/message are checked; an independent native list finds no invalid Supplier.
The public create command without an Access bearer exits3 with exact NOT_AUTHENTICATED error and empty stdout; native source confirms no Supplier was inserted.

Runtime's original nonofficer member uses a real post-restore Access session for public create. Live authentication and Seat admission precede native hat permissions. Exit4, exact ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED error and empty stdout are checked, and the Director's native source read confirms no insertion.
Public submit without an Access bearer exits3 with exact NOT_AUTHENTICATED error and empty stdout; native document and GL are identical before and after.
The member's real Access session calls public submit and exits4 with exact ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED error and empty stdout; independent native document and GL snapshots are unchanged.

After this runner's successful public ordinary submit, a new call id submits the same document again. It exits2 WRONG_STATE with exact error/empty stdout and changes neither native document nor GL. This is distinct from a successful same-id replay.
A nonexistent report is run publicly; exit2, exact INVALID_INPUT error/empty stdout and unchanged independent GL are checked.
Public report without an Access bearer exits3 with exact NOT_AUTHENTICATED error/empty stdout, and native GL stays unchanged.
The member's real Access session calls public General Ledger; it exits4 ROLE_PERMISSION_DENIED with exact error/empty stdout, and independent GL is unchanged.
